== zpdk/ar.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso zpdk/ar"
  vibox -40 -40 40 40
  vsym 0d6270b93aef47bc

pin A inout 0 -40
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000
pin B inout 0 40
  vplabel 0 0 R0 centerLeft stick 10000

param zq 1u
param nn 1
  kind int
param zq_area 200f
param qa 200f

impl spice spice
  format spectre "{name} ({A} {B}) ar zq={zq} nn={nn} zq_area={zq_area} qa={qa}"

rect -20 -20 20 20

stext 0 -30 R0 {name}
  size 1
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}
